description: November 6 birthday meaning: Scorpio decan 2, birthday number 6, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a November 6 birthday falls in Scorpio, in the second decan, with Pluto as the sign's ruler and Neptune as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 6. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Scorpio is fixed and water.

sections.heading: The November 6 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Thirteen degrees into Scorpio, November 6 carries Neptune's compassion and the birthday number 6's sense of duty to loved ones. Both point towards care, but in different registers: one intuitive, the other practical. Traditionally, this produces a deeply protective friend or parent who senses distress quickly and then quietly arranges help without making a fuss about it.

Astronomically, November 6 puts the Sun near 13° Scorpio in most years, inside the second ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Neptune. From 10 to 19 degrees of Scorpio, the sub-ruler is Neptune, modern ruler of Pisces. Early-to-mid November birthdays tend to soften the sign's intensity with intuition, imagination and empathy. These Scorpios are often seen as perceptive in an almost uncanny way, reading undercurrents in a room and drawn to art, healing work or spiritual questions. Neptune can blur edges, so feelings may be absorbed from others or idealised beyond recognition. The combination is powerful when grounded: deep emotional insight paired with compassion, used to help people face what they would rather not see alone.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for November 6
paragraphs: A birthday on the 6th produces a birthday number of 6, unreduced. As the secondary number in a chart, the day of birth hints at how someone naturally contributes to the people around them. The 6 is the number of the household in Pythagorean tradition: care, responsibility, beauty in the home and fairness within the family. Those born on the 6th are often the friend who remembers birthdays and notices when someone is struggling. Their usual lesson is that looking after others works best when they include themselves in the circle of care too.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a November 6 birthday gives Life Path 9 for 1990, 1 for 2000, 2 for 2010 and 3 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous November 6 birthdays
paragraphs: A November birthday falls in late autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of bare branches and early dusk, and in late spring for the southern, when the days lengthen fast. Scorpio holds most of the month, with Sagittarius arriving around November 22. In numerology November is month 11, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced and linked with intuition and inspiration. November 6 is the 310th day of the year (311st in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Sagittarius, is usually complete within 17 days, by November 23.

By November 6 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a November 6 birthday are Sally Field (1946), Robert Musil (1880) and Conchita Wurst (1988).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is November 6?
faq.answer: November 6 is Scorpio in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Scorpio, which tradition links with Neptune.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on November 6?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On November 6 the Life Path is 6 in 1960, 7 in 1970, 8 in 1980, 9 in 1990, 1 in 2000, 2 in 2010 and 3 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 6 for everyone born on the 6th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on November 6?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by November 6, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on November 6?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on November 6 include Sally Field (1946), Robert Musil (1880) and Conchita Wurst (1988). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
